name: gnomad_constraint
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file
method: One row per gene: the upstream file's Ensembl rows are kept where canonical == true and transcript_type == protein_coding, and 26 of its 55 columns are renamed onto a flat schema. The RefSeq (NM_/XM_) mirror rows are dropped because they carry neither a contig nor a transcript type, so the subset rule cannot be applied to them. constraint_flags is flattened from a quoted JSON array to a comma-separated string, because a TSV field containing a double quote is not readable by COPY ... FORMAT text. Scientific notation is rendered as a plain decimal and gnomAD's NA is passed through unchanged rather than becoming an empty field, so a missing metric stays distinguishable from a zero one. The panel BED is read only to report how many panel genes were found; it does not subset the output, which is genome-wide.

inputs.name: ressources/data-profile/mva_panel_grch38.bed
inputs.role: the gene panel: the intervals queried, and the symbols coverage is reported against

licence: gnomAD's primary data are released under the Creative Commons Zero Public Domain Dedication (CC0); attribution is requested, not required. This repository includes data from the gnomAD v4.1 release.
patient_data: none. Public reference data only - a gene, a transcript, a published classification or a literature range. This manifest records URLs, releases, digests and counts.
note: 18,314 genes from gnomAD v4.1, one canonical protein-coding Ensembl transcript each. Autosomes only upstream: the file carries no sex-chromosome row at all, so a gene absent from it is not unconstrained.
